### Bug Fixes in Existing Tests

**Files modified:**
- `frontend/src/shared/lib/__tests__/queryClient.test.ts` — Fixed staleTime assertion from `1000 * 60` (60000ms / 1 min) to `1000 * 60 * 5` (300000ms / 5 min) to match actual `queryClient.ts` source
- `frontend/src/shared/lib/__tests__/queryClient.edge.test.ts` — Same correction for the exact-value assertion

**Reason:** The implementation at `queryClient.ts` configures `staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5` (5 minutes) but existing tests incorrectly asserted `60_000` (1 minute). These were pre-existing test bugs, not implementation bugs.
